v2_root_fact: Lead reports v2 programmable configuration/readback/count enable succeeded; v3 CPU getter not exposed by installed digest.

kpc_sysctl.observation: KPC sysctl uses ktrace_read_check, not ktrace_configure; all-CPU counter request returns count plus current CPU header.

force_ownership.observation: Foreign forced task is refused; successful acquire/release updates owning task and notifies power manager.

pet_payload.observation: Fallback initializes counterc32; failed thread getter keeps width, zeroes buffer, logs eight DATA rows.

thread_fallback.observation: Missing thread kpc_buf returns EINVAL without changing inoutcount; AST lazily allocates buffers.

ktrace_permission.observation: ktrace_read_check grants root independently of the owning trace PID; no trace acquisition.

private_api_abi.observation: kpc_get_cpu_counters(bool all_cpus,uint32 classes,int *current_cpu,uint64 *buf),0 success; buffer ncpu*counter_count; KPC sysctl wrapper.
